title: Patch: holding down a card with several fusions shows a black screen
notes: Issue #3863: holding a fused card (a single fusion or a fusion of fusions, R179) opened the full-screen art view over an id in no catalog, so every plane drew url("") and the screen was black. fullScreenArtId (cards/art/fusedArt.ts) picks the catalog card the view draws (the host of a Miner or Weapon fusion, R3045000, else the Dormant Starship hull or the last ingredient the catalog knows); useCanOpenFullScreen refuses a fusion no art resolves for (a digest id, R468), and FullScreenArt draws from the resolved id (R3345000). How cards play is unchanged.

player.title: Holding a fused card shows its art
fixes: Holding down a card with one or more fusions on it opens its full-screen art instead of a black screen.
